articles.title: Mindgruve Appoints Spencer Lian-Thornton as VP of Growth and Partnerships
articles.mainIdea: Mindgruve Appoints Spencer Lian-Thornton as VP of Growth and Partnerships
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Mindgruve Appoints Spencer Lian-Thornton as VP of Growth and Partnerships. Mindgruve, a modern media, commerce, and data technology company, today announced the appointment of Spencer Lian-Thornton as Vice President of Growth and Partnerships, effective January 2, 2026. Lian-Thornton will play a key role in accelerating Mindgruve's growth, deepening enterprise partnerships, and advancing the agency's leadership in retail media and commerce-driven marketing.
